methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $2M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
ADMARES is a seed-stage company operating in Housing & Construction, founded by Mikael Hedberg. The private comp universe consists of five frontier-tech peers in the sector: BotBuilt, Apis Cor, Unlimited Industries, Ground Control Development, and Hedral. No direct public comparables are available, limiting the scope of triangulation methods.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable and forms the basis of valuation analysis. Using total capital raised of $1.78M as a proxy for seed-stage value, a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of progression from seed to Series A yields an implied valuation of $4.45M. This reflects the conventional risk-adjusted premium applied to early-stage capital deployment in the construction tech sector.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $3.78M to $5.12M (low to high), with a median point of $4.45M. The constraint on this assessment is methodological: reliance on a single applicable triangulation method limits confidence. Absence of public comps and the early-stage nature of the target preclude revenue multiples or DCF anchoring. Key uncertainties include the actual post-money valuation from the most recent round (undisclosed), the development stage and IP maturity of ADMARES relative to named private peers, and sector-specific risk factors in construction automation adoption. The narrow comp set also means peer financials are unavailable for benchmarking. Further clarity on fundraising terms and relative positioning within the peer cohort would refine the range materially.
